title: `NUMBER` arithmetic: its types, half-up rounding, and values past 38 digits
verdict: types by Snowflake's rules; rescaling rounds half away from zero; results keep up to 2^127 past 38 digits (SF-1)
description: Result types: `NUMBER(5,1) + NUMBER(6,2)` is `NUMBER(7,2)`, `*` adds the scales (`NUMBER(11,3)`), capped at the larger of 12 and the inputs' scales (`NUMBER(20,13) * NUMBER(20,13)` has scale 13, `NUMBER(38,10) * NUMBER(38,10)` scale 12), `/` has the dividend's scale plus 6 in every case probed (`NUMBER(5,1) / NUMBER(6,2)` is `NUMBER(13,7)`), `SUM` adds 12 digits of precision and `AVG` 6 of scale.

Rescaling rounds half away from zero: `CAST(1.25 AS NUMBER(10,1))` is 1.3, `-1.25` gives -1.3, `2.5` cast to `NUMBER(10,0)` is 3, `2/3` at scale 8 is `0.66666667`. `ROUND(x, d)` rounds half away from zero; `ROUND(x, 0, 'HALF_TO_EVEN')` rounds to even.

A cast that does not fit raises `Number out of representable range` (`1000` to `NUMBER(3,0)`, `9.999` to `NUMBER(3,2)`). Arithmetic does not: `99999999999999999999999999999999999999 + 1` is `10^38`, 39 digits, still typed `NUMBER(38,0)`, castable to `NUMBER(38,0)` without an error and printed with 39 digits. The limit is 128 bits: `2^64 * 2^64` raises, and so does a `SUM` past 2^127 (`Value overflow in a SUM aggregate`). See [SF-1](../../../upstream/bugs/SF-1.json).
reference: Decimal arithmetic with the YAML's result types, `decimal_rescale: TIE_AWAY_FROM_ZERO`, `overflow: ERROR` past the declared precision. sverify does not write decimals for Snowflake yet (`Dialect.decimals` is off, #27), so the plans that use them are refused.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1.5::NUMBER(5,1) + 2.25::NUMBER(6,2)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1.5::NUMBER(5,1) - 2.25::NUMBER(6,2)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1.5::NUMBER(5,1) * 2.25::NUMBER(6,2)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1.5::NUMBER(5,1) / 2.25::NUMBER(6,2)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::NUMBER(38,10) * 1::NUMBER(38,10)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::NUMBER(38,20) / 3::NUMBER(38,20)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(-1.5::NUMBER(5,1)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(abs(-1.5::NUMBER(5,1))), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(mod(7.5::NUMBER(5,1), 2::NUMBER(3,0)))
evidence.observed: (NUMBER(7,2)[SB2], NUMBER(7,2)[SB1], NUMBER(11,3)[SB2], NUMBER(13,7)[SB4], NUMBER(38,12)[SB8], NUMBER(38,20)[SB16], NUMBER(5,1)[SB1], NUMBER(5,1)[SB1], NUMBER(5,1)[SB1])

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
